author: Zach Hennessy
text: These guys are awesome from top to bottom. Very friendly and easy to work with when setting up appointments and disclosed everything I needed to be prepared for with pricing. Boyd and Dacota came out to empty and they were professional, courteous, and all around just great to work with. I recently bought my home and have had trouble finding the buried cap and they even went above and beyond by helping me probe/locate the tanks cap so I could dig it up on my own at a later time. They’ll be my go-to in the future for sure! 10/10.

author: Virginia Hensley
text: This is our second time using Bishop and we really appreciate their friendly service, and professionalism. This last service call they noticed that the leach field needed to be switched. I couldn’t find the tool to do it but Boyd and Josh came to the rescue and found one in their truck. Grateful for honest service and people we can trust!

author: simone Vaughn
text: I called Bishops after having a backup due to a clog.  They were able to get me in the very next morning.  Boyd and Josh were so professional they called to let me know they were on their way.  Arrived at the beginning of the time slot they gave me.  They took time to explain everything to my husband and myself.  They even called after leaving to give to my husband some extra information they thought would be helpful in maintaining the system.  Very friendly, professional, and clean.  I will definitely be using them moving forward.

author: Bara Madson
text: Josh and Boyd were amazing! Prompt and called ahead. Very professional and thorough! They checked all that was needed for my septic and were very efficient. HIGHLY RECOMMEND! Very fair pricing and will definitely use again!

author: Socs Wise
text: Had septic backup issue called Bishop and they were great. They got to us fast provided a clean out. Thank you service and price were great.
